name: Powered Cycle (L1e-A)
description: The EU's type-approved e-bike past the EPAC's limits: a cycle designed to pedal whose auxiliary propulsion of no more than 1,000 W mainly aids pedalling, may have a throttle, and cuts off by 25 km/h. It needs EU type approval but no EU driving licence.

restrictions.rule: Needs EU type approval: it may be sold, registered or put into service only with the manufacturer's certificate of conformity, and carries the manufacturer's statutory plate
Its frame, front fork, seat-post and handlebar stem must pass the bicycle tests of ISO 4210:2014, at the delegated regulation's minimum forces
The manufacturer must fit features that stop its powertrain being tampered with to raise its power, torque or maximum design speed
No EU driving licence category covers it: the AM moped licence excludes vehicles with a maximum design speed of 25 km/h or less

Within the Motor Insurance Directive's compulsory insurance only if it's propelled exclusively by mechanical power and its net weight is over 25 kg; one whose propulsion only aids pedalling is outside it, and a member state may still require insurance under national law
restrictions.citation: Directive 2009/103/EC, Arts. 1(1), 3, as amended by Directive (EU) 2021/2118; Directive (EU) 2021/2118, recitals 4, 6
